title: He Had 1 Job for 14 Days
description:
Mrs. Lee asked Marlo to water her fern for two weeks. He forgot. Every single day.

Watch how one dead plant turned into a million-dollar idea, the heatwave that nearly ruined it, and the postcards that beat MegaSock's robots.

New Marble Street story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next business.

Marble Street is an animated series about creative business ideas. Marlo, his street and every event are fictional. Made with AI tools (animation and voice).
